name: model_op_swiglu
description: SwiGLU activation as used by FlagGems-vllm on Ascend (FlagGems-vllm PR #728, src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_ascend/ops/swiglu.py). input_tensor [..., 2H] float16/bfloat16/float32 is split in half along the last dimension into (a, b); the result is silu(a) * b with shape [..., H] and the input dtype. The last dimension must be even. silu and the product are evaluated in float32 and rounded once on the way out, matching torch_npu.npu_swiglu(input_tensor, dim=-1). Returns a new tensor; the input is not modified.
